title: SliderConfig
description: Serializable configuration for the RibbonUI slider atom.

id.description: Stable slider instance identifier; also the native input DOM id.

value.description: Controlled numeric value owned by the host.

step.description: Step between allowed values; 0 is treated as any by the host.

name.description: Form field name for native form submission.

size.description: Explicit control density and target size.

disabled.description: Whether native activation and focus participation are disabled.
